Psoriasis is a chronic proliferative and inflammatory condition of the skin.
It is characterized by erythematous plaques covered with silvery scales, particularly over the extensor surfaces, scalp, and lumbosacral region.
This activity reviews the pathophysiology, presentation, and diagnosis of psoriasis and highlights the role of the interprofessional team in its management.
List the treatment and management options available for psoriasis.
Discuss interprofessional team strategies for improving care coordination and outcomes in patients with psoriasis.
Physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists must collaborate to provide effective patient education and coordinate care for optimal outcomes.
